name: IPTV
description: Live TV with a programme guide, movies and series from Dispatcharr (Xtream). Search, reminders, the next episode and a merged programme guide.
requires: Dispatcharr (https://github.com/Dispatcharr/Dispatcharr), reachable from the Couchmate server, with an Xtream user.

settings.label: Dispatcharr address
settings.help: How the Couchmate server reaches Dispatcharr. In Docker, e.g. http://dispatcharr:9191 or http://host.docker.internal:9191.

options.label: Proxy – all video goes through Couchmate (recommended)
Direct – the apps fetch from Dispatcharr

settings.label: Public Dispatcharr address
settings.help: Only for direct mode: the address the apps use to reach Dispatcharr.

settings.label: Shared movie download
settings.help: Movies and episodes are fetched once and shared with everyone – only one provider connection. Needs proxy mode.

settings.label: Merged guide: primary guide (XMLTV link)
settings.help: Your provider's XMLTV. Empty = no merged guide. Point Dispatcharr's EPG source at /plugins/iptv/epg/merged.xml.gz?pin=<PIN>.

settings.label: Merged guide: fallback for countries
settings.help: "auto" = the countries of your channels, or e.g. "se,no".

settings.label: Merged guide: fallback source per country
settings.help: {CC} is replaced by the country code, e.g. SE.

settings.label: Merged guide: extra fallback sources
settings.help: More XMLTV links, separated by commas.
